reporting-org.narrative: European Commission - Directorate-General for International Partnerships

title.narrative: Resilience, inclusivity, support, and equality (RISE): leading to a democratic society through empowerment of CSOs in Tajikistan

description.narrative: The overall objective of the action is to contribute to a resilient and inclusive society in Tajikistan, especially focusing on vulnerable and marginalized groups such as ethnic minorities, women, youth, and PwD, and promote human rights awareness and fundamental freedoms by engaging and supporting local CSOs in the democratic governance. The specific objectives are 1) to strengthen local CSOs, grassroot organizations, and civic activists¿ capacities to monitor implementation of human rights commitments with a special focus on vulnerable groups, including women, youth, ethnic minorities, and PwD; and 2) to increase minority groups¿ participation and inclusion of vulnerable groups at the local, regional, and national levels in Tajikistan.
